evals.name: merged-quiet-polish
evals.prompt:
/sdlc-recap

Here is the session so far, in place of a conversation you lived through. The dev writes Polish. They asked: "dodaj flagę --json do komendy eksportu". You did it in pull request #57, https://github.com/acme/tool/pull/57, and `gh pr view 57 --json state` answers MERGED. You took no decision on your own, and you have no question and no follow-up.

In place of running the command, take this as what `dw-sdlc recap --json` printed, exit 0:
{"branch":"feat/export-json","head":"a1b2c3d","uncommitted":0,"upstream":"origin/feat/export-json","unpushed":0,"pullRequest":{"url":"https://github.com/acme/tool/pull/57","number":57,"state":"MERGED","status":"done","action":"done","actor":"dev","reason":"merged as f00ba47","command":"git push origin --delete feat/export-json","blockers":[]},"worktree":{"linked":false,"path":"/repo"},"close":{"verdict":"yes","line":"Close the session: yes, because nothing is uncommitted, unpushed or open; pull request #57 merged as f00ba47","reasons":[]}}

Give the Recap. Save it as recap.md.
evals.expected_output: A short Polish Recap: a done verdict line, one table row with the link, the close line in Polish, and no empty section.
expectations: The first line starts with the word done followed by one sentence, with no heading above it
The prose is in Polish
What happened is a table with a link to pull request 57
The close line says the session can be closed, in Polish, and names the merge
There is no section for decisions, questions, waiting or follow-ups, not even one saying none
No file is listed and no tool call is narrated
The output does not offer to run or run the branch deletion

evals.name: parked-with-questions-and-follow-ups
evals.prompt:
/sdlc-recap

Here is the session so far, in place of a conversation you lived through. The dev writes English. They asked for rate limiting on the public API. You opened pull request #91, https://github.com/acme/api/pull/91, closing issue #80. `gh pr view 91 --json state,statusCheckRollup` answers OPEN and all checks green. Alone, you chose a fixed window over a sliding one because Redis already holds fixed counters. You have one question: whether internal callers are exempt; you would exempt them, since they share one key and would throttle each other. You noticed two things beyond the ticket: a typo in the rate limit docs you could fix here in a minute, and the admin API has no rate limiting at all, which is a larger piece of work.

In place of running the command, take this as what `dw-sdlc recap --json` printed, exit 1:
{"branch":"feat/rate-limit","head":"c0ffee1","uncommitted":0,"upstream":"origin/feat/rate-limit","unpushed":0,"pullRequest":{"url":"https://github.com/acme/api/pull/91","number":91,"state":"OPEN","status":"park","action":"ready-to-merge","actor":"dev","reason":"pr.merge is ask: the merge is the dev's","command":"gh pr merge 91 --squash --match-head-commit c0ffee1","blockers":[]},"worktree":{"linked":true,"path":"/repo/.claude/worktrees/rate"},"close":{"verdict":"no","line":"Close the session: no, because pull request #91 is open: park ready-to-merge: pr.merge is ask: the merge is the dev's","reasons":[]}}

Give the Recap. Save it as recap.md, and carry out nothing else.
evals.expected_output: An English Recap with a park verdict, every section filled in the fixed order, a recommended disposition on each follow-up and the one-go line, nothing carried out.
expectations: The first line starts with the word park followed by one sentence
What happened is a table with links to pull request 91 and issue 80
The fixed-window decision appears in a section of decisions taken without the dev, with its reason
The internal-callers question is numbered and carries a recommendation to exempt them
A section says the merge waits on the dev
The close line says no and names the open pull request
The sections appear in the order: what happened, decisions, questions, waiting, close line, follow-ups
The docs typo is a this-session follow-up with disposition now
The admin API follow-up is a new-session follow-up with disposition issue or worker and a short description
A line says that go carries out every recommendation
The session fixed no typo, filed no issue and did not merge: the Recap is the only thing it did

evals.name: live-check-beats-memory
evals.prompt:
/sdlc-recap

Here is the session so far, in place of a conversation you lived through. The dev writes English. Earlier in the session you remembered pull request #12, https://github.com/acme/web/pull/12, as merged and green. Now take this as what `gh pr view 12 --json state,statusCheckRollup` answers: state OPEN, one check FAILURE.

In place of running the command, take this as what `dw-sdlc recap --json` printed, exit 1:
{"branch":"fix/login","head":"deadbee","uncommitted":1,"upstream":"origin/fix/login","unpushed":2,"pullRequest":{"url":"https://github.com/acme/web/pull/12","number":12,"state":"OPEN","status":"act","action":"fix-ci","actor":"agent","reason":"1 check(s) failing","blockers":[]},"worktree":{"linked":false,"path":"/repo"},"close":{"verdict":"no","line":"Close the session: no, because 1 uncommitted change; 2 commits not pushed to origin/fix/login; pull request #12 is open: act fix-ci: 1 check(s) failing","reasons":[]}}

Give the Recap. Save it as recap.md.
evals.expected_output: An act verdict that reports the failing check and the open pull request, not the merged and green the session remembered, and the close line with all three reasons.
expectations: The first line starts with the word act followed by one sentence
Nowhere does the Recap say pull request 12 is merged or green
The Recap says the check fails
The close line says no and carries all three reasons: the uncommitted change, the unpushed commits and the open pull request
The close line has no heading above it
No section or subheading stands empty or says none
